title: Quiet unattended mode: decide, log, keep going

short.lead: Unattended mode still stops. This plan closes 12 ways it can ask or quit, after two independent reviews. I need one approval line from you.
short.hint: Tap a step to see it.
items: In auto or normal mode, only choices about how something looks or what it does come to you. In unattended or bypass, I decide those too, state my assumption, and carry on. Once a goal is set, I work its steps to the end.

items.alt: A choice about look or function goes to you; any other choice I decide and log
items.caption: Who decides what

items: Keep going until the goal is met
The plan becomes numbered steps. A check on every reply blocks the stop while a step is open, in every mode. A second loop outside the session restarts it if it quits.

items.alt: A goal check blocks the stop until the goal is met
items.caption: Why it stops today and what changes

items: Each decision goes into one file as I make it. You first see them on the QA page, once everything is built and tested.

items.alt: Decisions are written quietly during build and test, then shown on the QA page
items.caption: When you see the decisions

items: Your approval is recorded as one line in the decisions log.

changes: changed
Rules tell me to ask, wait or stop
Ask about look or function only when you are here

In auto or normal mode, only choices about how something looks or what it does come to you. A new dependency, a data format or an API change counts as function. In unattended or bypass I decide those too. Everything else I decide and log, in every mode.

Today: rules say to ask, wait or hand over (show-dont-tell.md:5, 11, 12; house-rules.md:91; clear-writing.md:59-62; handover-command.md:28, 51; commit-branches.md:50; coding-philosophy.md:58; builder.md:11; core.py:1546, 1610).
New: those lines are rewritten. Hard stops stay yours: a licence, a login, a purchase, a deletion, money, secrets, other people, outward posts.
For you: far fewer questions in every mode, and none in unattended or bypass.
new
One test for who is present
Unattended and bypass count as nobody present
Unattended and bypass mean nobody is here, and the loop runs alone. Auto mode keeps you present: the design loop still gates every step. Auto still gets every change that cuts your decisions.
Today: only unattended and bypass are recognised, in separate places (core.py:1487, 2794, 3840; safe_git.py:1375, 1638, 1935; bigfiles.py:150; design_loop.py:3555).

New: one helper that all those places use. When nobody is here, a permission prompt is denied at once, a plan-exit prompt is allowed, and pause-goal is denied. Agent writes to house-rules-mode.json and HOUSE_RULES_ keys in .claude/settings are refused.

For you: auto keeps your gates but asks far less: rules, step check, ledger and QA-only reporting all apply. The launcher is still best overnight, because auto mode has its own safety check I cannot rewrite.
changed
Unattended switches the design loop off
Unattended keeps the design loop and runs it itself
The loop stays on. I design, decide, have a helper review the plan, approve it, build the steps and hand over a QA page.
Today: unattended turns the loop and the end-of-reply check off (core.py:2723, 2737, 2850; hook.py:122; design_loop.py:2952).

New: the end-of-reply check comes back for these items only: evidence, commit, deviation, QA page, changelog, decision log. The editor, page limit, plain summary, page send, helpers and issues stay off.
For you: the loop flows without you from goal to QA, ending on the finish line below.
new
I can approve my own plan, but only a hook records it
A hook approves, and only when a real review exists

The hook may move Design to Plan, and Plan to Build, with the issue-label read skipped. It needs the unattended switch or bypass mode, never auto, a stored reviewer verdict for this page's hash, and a build plan with a test command per step.

Today: only your typed message moves the stage, and the stage file refuses agent writes (design_loop.py:429, 621, 1157, 1418). The review stamp is self-declared (make_page.py:609), and the verdict hook is off when helpers are off (delegation.py:740).

New: a verdict hook for reviewer helpers stays on, and writes the verdict and page hash to the stage file. QA passed and Close approved stay yours. The newest-approval marker (design_loop.py:525) is not touched, so your other branches stay open.
For you: every self-approval is the first row on the QA page.
new
A step list I cannot shrink
Steps live in a guarded file, one per session

A hook copies the steps from the reviewed build plan into the stage file, with a hash, under the launcher's session id. Only that session is blocked by them, and only for features approved after this change.
Today: no step list exists. Parking has no category (ledger_note.py:43-46), and deviate only adds a ledger row.

New: a step passes when I run ledger_note.py check for it, through a normal Bash call, so every guard and timeout applies. A hook records the exit code and the commit; a moved commit makes it stale. The hash is also kept outside the repo.
For you: a step is parked only with a hard-stop category and the command that showed it. Deviate may add or replace a step, never delete one, and never touch the four finish-line steps.
new
A finish line, the same in every mode
Four required last steps on every step list
Every step list, in every mode, ends with the same four steps. None can be parked, replaced, deleted or skipped, and QA cannot open until all four pass.
Today: QA starts when a pull request opens or every issue says needs review (design_loop.py:860, 872). Nothing checks tests, docs or pictures first.

New: 1 tests pass (verify.py exits 0). 2 docs written (the changed docs tier and CHANGELOG.md have new lines). 3 before-and-after pictures saved under docs/qa, or a check that no visual file changed. 4 QA page built and stamped.
For you: you reach QA only with tests green, docs written and pictures to look at.
new
A check on every stop
One fixed check reads the step list; no model decides
The check runs on every stop, even with no reply text. A missing step file for an active session counts as open. The words NEEDS YOU no longer exempt anything; only a parked step does.
Today: two phrases trigger it, and two blocks end it (core.py:3516, 3518, 3731, 3835, 3840, 3869). The 6 at core.py:3684 is unused and is deleted.

New: the existing shared counter (core.py:3655) is reused. After 3 blocks with no step closed and no commit, a step is marked stuck, shown on QA, and the check moves on. overnight.sh sets CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP to 0.
For you: the model judge blocks at most once per step set. Sessions with no step list keep the current goal check. The web app keeps Claude Code's cap of 8 blocks.
new
Look or function choices when nobody is here
Decide with a stated assumption, list it first on QA
In unattended or bypass I decide these myself. I record my assumption and why it is reasonable, then carry on. In auto mode, a reply ending QUESTION FOR YOU: is allowed.
Today: a plain question in Build parks, and a [HARD STOP] question holds edits (design_loop.py:1401, 1547).
New: ledger_note.py decide adds a C row (choice) with an Assumption column, and a new message from you clears any block. The ledger is named after the branch, with / changed to - (make_page.py:53).
For you: QA lists these assumptions and auto-approvals first, with why and how to undo each.
new
A restart loop outside the session
overnight.sh becomes a loop that runs Claude without a window

It starts with --session-id, then resumes by id with --resume and -p after any stop, never by most recent session. The resume text is marked relayed (core.py:2040), so it never counts as your approval.
Today: overnight.sh runs Claude once and sits idle after any stop (tools/overnight.sh:12; test tools/verify_tools.py:813). Rate limits end the turn with no way to block it.

New: a small script that runs when a stop fails writes the error and reset time to a file. The loop waits for the reset, not counting it, and backs off after crashes. A last short run builds the QA page. overnight.sh --interactive keeps the old behaviour.
For you: limits are 24 hours of work and 5 restarts with no step closed. They end the run into QA with open steps listed first. This is the one exception to never stopping.
changed
Decisions shown too early
Decisions appear only on the QA page

Guard refusals, denied questions and the unattended note all tell me to report in the reply. They change to: write it to the ledger and carry on with the next open step. The QA reply says how many were logged.
Today: replies must list refusals under Waiting on you (safe_git.py:1584, 1620) and questions in the final report (core.py:2800, 2958; overnight.sh:4).
New: the ledger gets them. A hard stop parks its step and I continue with the others. A pull request to main may be opened by me, never merged.
For you: you see nothing about decisions until the QA page.
changed
Gates that freeze a run nobody can answer
Skipped when nobody is present

With the loop on, a reply that asks a question holds edits, unreadable GitHub refuses them, and unlabelled issues refuse them. Nobody can clear these. In unattended and bypass the step list, not a pull request, moves Build to QA.
New: when nobody is present, the holds and label checks are skipped, and a pull request opens only when every step is done, stuck or parked. Attended sessions do not change.
For you: the speed-first build already in Build is not affected; this plan waits for it to leave Build.
changed
Earlier decisions reversed
Twelve earlier decisions are reversed, each logged
Each gets a dated entry in docs/6-decisions/Decisions.md and a pointer left in the old one.
Today: Decisions.md lines 22, 54, 87, 92, 101, 121, 126, 133, 141 and 143 stand, plus the rule that approval comes only from your message, and Nothing fails silently.
New: all twelve are reversed. The relaxed credit check stays relaxed, and a final check strips credit lines before a pull request opens.
For you: tests change in checks/core.py, checks/design_loop.py, checks/safe_git.py and tools/verify_tools.py, with new cases for self-approval, the step file, the counter and the loop.
choices: Do you approve this plan as written?
Closes all twelve holes together, after three review rounds.
Tell me what, in your own words.
I recommend A. Any hole left open would still let a run stop.

wrapup.summary: Twelve rule, hook and launcher problems (plus twelve reversals) make unattended mode ask or quit, and this plan replaces them with decide, log, and keep going.
wrapup.changing: Rules, hooks, guards, the step file, ledger_note.py, make_page.py, hooks.json, tools/overnight.sh, the tests, the docs and the changelog.
wrapup.blocking: Your approval line; no code is touched until you send it.
wrapup.next: Send "Design approved: quiet unattended mode". Then I write the build plan page for you to approve, then build and test a real headless run.
